purpose: Convert CSD-034 impact frontiers into dependency-safe recovery plans, execute eligible repairs in deterministic order, reconcile resulting state, and reopen only proven-consistent production nodes.
core_principle: Recovery repairs derived state without rewriting history; autonomous action is permitted only inside explicit safety boundaries.
ordering_rules: Canonical source truth is resolved before derived repair.
Leaf derivatives are repaired before dependent aggregates.
Scene-state and event-state reconciliation precedes frame regeneration.
Asset dependency reconciliation precedes production re-execution.
Successful result validation precedes cross-scene QA.
Cross-scene QA precedes reopening dependent scene production.
Failed recovery nodes remain quarantined and cannot silently reopen.

recovery_outcomes.RECOVERY_PASSED: All affected active nodes reconciled and eligible for production.
recovery_outcomes.RECOVERY_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS: No blocking inconsistency remains; warnings are recorded.
recovery_outcomes.RECOVERY_BLOCKED: A canonical or authorization boundary prevents autonomous recovery.
recovery_outcomes.RECOVERY_FAILED: An authorized repair was attempted but validation failed.
recovery_outcomes.QUARANTINED: A node remains isolated until missing evidence or lineage is restored.

safety_invariants: Historical canonical scene versions remain immutable.
Every autonomous action creates an auditable recovery event.
Every regenerated asset receives new lineage; old versions remain preserved.
A failed replacement never destroys the last valid version.
Recovery cannot activate an inactive narrative branch.
Recovery cannot exceed five active scene characters.
Recovery cannot bypass CSD-032 or CSD-033.
Recovery must be idempotent: repeating the same plan does not create uncontrolled duplicate work.
